description: The third reachable input shape for the normalisation at app/cbl/COADM01C.cbl:117-125, and the one that proves the chain IDEMPOTENT: a re-entry carrying CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT 1, an AID of DFHENTER and OPTIONI '03' - two digits, no space anywhere - which is the ALREADY ZERO-PADDED form of an option. Line 87's IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is false, so the ELSE at 91 runs: RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN, then the ordered three-way EVALUATE at 93-103, whose FIRST arm is DFHENTER and whose WHEN OTHER is last, so PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is what runs. The five normalisation steps with every intermediate value, and the whole point of this case is that TWO OF THEM CHANGE NOTHING: (1) the descending scan at 117-121 has an EMPTY BODY, and PERFORM VARYING ... UNTIL is TEST-BEFORE - it sets WS-IDX from LENGTH OF OPTIONI, which is 2 because app/cpy-bms/COADM01.CPY:132 declares OPTIONI PIC X(2), then evaluates the condition BEFORE running anything, finds byte 2 holding '3' which is NOT = SPACES, and stops IMMEDIATELY with WS-IDX = 2, never decrementing and never executing the body once; (2) line 122 sends OPTIONI(1:WS-IDX) - two characters here, because WS-IDX resolved to 2 - into WS-OPTION-X; (3) WS-OPTION-X is declared PIC X(02) JUST RIGHT at line 45, and a two-character sender entering a two-character right-justified receiver has nothing to shift and no room to fill, so the RIGHT-JUSTIFICATION IS A NO-OP and the field holds '03'; (4) line 123's INSPECT WS-OPTION-X REPLACING ALL ' ' BY '0' finds NO SPACE to replace, so IT IS A NO-OP TOO and the field still holds '03'; (5) line 124 moves those two characters into WS-OPTION PIC 9(02), which is 3, and line 125 echoes WS-OPTION into OPTIONO as '03'. The received OPTIONI and the echoed OPTIONO are therefore the SAME two characters, and that identity is the assertion: a translation that normalised UNCONDITIONALLY - left-justifying the pair into '30', or substituting over digits rather than only over spaces, or trimming and re-padding a value that needed neither - would corrupt input that was already correct, and it would do so ONLY on well-formed input, where no other case would notice. The chain is thus driven at each of its three reachable shapes: case07 delivers the unpadded '1 ', whose scan decrements to WS-IDX = 1 and whose JUST RIGHT and INSPECT both do real work; case09 delivers '02' at option 2; and this case delivers '03' at option 3, where both steps are inert. The guard at 127-129 is evaluated in source order and every term is false: WS-OPTION IS NOT NUMERIC is false because the field holds two digits, WS-OPTION > CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT is false because app/cpy/COADM02Y.cpy:20 declares that count 4 and this is 3, and WS-OPTION = ZEROS is false - so no message is composed, SEND-MENU-SCREEN is not performed from 133, and WS-ERR-FLG stays 'N'. Line 137's IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON therefore holds, and line 138 reference-modifies the first five characters of CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-PGMNAME(WS-OPTION): COBOL subscript 3 - Java position 2, the one-based-to-zero-based conversion this case pins at the THIRD element of a table whose OCCURS 9 at app/cpy/COADM02Y.cpy:45 is populated only to 4 - selects the entry declared at app/cpy/COADM02Y.cpy:34-37, PIC 9(02) VALUE 3 with the PIC X(35) name 'User Update (Security)' and the PIC X(08) program name 'COUSR02C', whose first five characters are 'COUSR' and are not 'DUMMY', so the transfer arm runs and the successor is COUSR02C. Lines 139-141 make EXACTLY THREE mutations to the communication area, in source order: CDEMO-FROM-TRANID becomes 'CA00' from WS-TRANID at line 37, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM becomes 'COADM01C' from WS-PGMNAME at line 36, and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT becomes zero, so COUSR02C sees ENTER and paints rather than validating. Every other one of the sixteen fields of the 160-byte area is echoed byte for byte, which is the assertion of statelessness: COADM01C reads no other context field and writes no other, and the conversation state travels in the payload rather than in a server-side session. The XCTL at 142-145 DOES specify COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA), so the whole area of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy is handed to COUSR02C - unlike the sign-on transfer at 165-167, which names only a program and passes no communication area at all. An XCTL never returns, and that is what the rest of this expectation is about. Lines 147-154 sit after the inner END-IF on line 146, so they are TEXTUALLY reachable and are kept out only by the transfer never coming back: a translation that returned from the transfer arm and fell through would blank WS-MESSAGE at 147, move DFHGREEN over the map's declared colour at 148, compose the two-operand STRING at 149-153 into the message and send it at 154, attaching a composed message to a SUCCESSFUL transfer - which COADM01C never emits. Its absence is therefore asserted positively rather than merely left unstated: the one expected message is the 80-byte WS-MESSAGE of line 38 still holding the spaces line 79 put in it, on the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel because WS-MESSAGE is WORKING-STORAGE and not the 78-byte ERRMSGO screen field that line 177 narrows it into, and the text composed at 149-153 is quoted NOWHERE in this file - deliberately, so that a search for it across the fixture tree finds case08, the case that does emit it, and not this one. Neither is anything repainted. SEND-MENU-SCREEN is not performed, so POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at 174 paints no title, transaction, program, date or time, BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS at 175 composes none of the twelve option lines, and the empty send list is a positive assertion of exactly that. With no send there is no ScreenSend to carry an attribute either, so the error-message colour is never written and stays the COLOR=RED the map declares - reproduced as BmsAttributes.DFHRED and reported as the outcome's own message colour - while the DFHGREEN of line 148 is the only attribute byte the program ever writes and it belongs to the path this case does not take. The reset signal is likewise NOT asserted: MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COADM1AO at line 89 sits inside the first-entry branch ONLY and cannot run on a re-entry. The normalised '03' is asserted at the unit rather than here, because a transfer sends no map for the echoed option to travel on. nextMapset and nextMap are deliberately NOT declared: neither XCTL names a map - line 143 names only the option's program name and line 166 only CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM - and which screen COUSR02C paints is COUSR02C's decision, taken after this program has ended, so naming the screen being left would be the one answer that is certainly wrong. The map and mapset this run did touch are COADM1A of COADM01, at the RECEIVE on 191-197 and in the RETURN TRANSID('CA00') that app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD binds to this program, and they are recorded here in prose rather than as an expectation for that reason. Also declared, and unread by the program, are OPTN005I through OPTN012I: BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS composes only lines 1 to 4 because the count is 4, and the line 89 reset does not run on a re-entry, so those eight lines are delivered as the spaces their INITIAL leaves them holding. They are stated explicitly so that the no-reset state is well defined rather than accidental, and as spaces rather than low values precisely because low values are the marker of the reset that did not happen. Only OPTIONI is read. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:32, the timestamp COADM01C's own version footer at line 267 carries, so the instant is anchored in the source rather than chosen; all twenty cases in this directory pin that same instant and name US-ASCII explicitly rather than leaving a code page to a platform default. This path paints no header, so the instant changes nothing it asserts; it is declared all the same so that one clock governs the whole directory. Every expected value above is STATICALLY DERIVED - read out of the COBOL paragraph that produces it and cross-checked against the 160-byte layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the option table of app/cpy/COADM02Y.cpy, the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COADM01.CPY and the DFHMDF definitions of app/bms/COADM01.bms - and NONE of it was captured from, recorded against or replayed from an execution of the legacy program, which is empirically impossible here: no z/OS or CICS runtime, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository. ParityCase's own class documentation is the authoritative statement of that provenance, and the substitution of provenance - and of provenance alone, since the twenty cases, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-equals-zero gate all stand - is escalated for explicit confirmation rather than silently absorbed (risk R-A).
